# Upstream link codec fixtures

`link-binary-upstream.json` was generated on 2026-11-22 from the untouched
TypeScript oracle at fork commit `780bf31fc`. The recorder imported upstream
`packages/chord/src/link/binary.ts` and `text.ts` using Node's
`--conditions=source`. No upstream source was edited.

Each of the 19 message tags has its tag name, binary bytes in `hex`, and
segmented text bytes in `textHex`. The matching Rust message constructors
are in `tests/link.rs`. Tags cover hello, hold, release, call, abort, bound,
state, failed, result, error, gone, retry, loading, ack, closed, ping, pong,
revoke and event. Tests compare
Rust output byte-for-byte with the generated bytes and decode the same bytes.
The recorded cases include origin/trace envelopes, raw JSON and bytes parts,
UUID incarnations and optional fields. These are format fixtures, not claims
of exhaustive malformed-input or performance equivalence.

Source SHA-256 at recording:

- `binary.ts`: `1e8b03bfd3cba804efef525ac69eef9a907926ee19627299fafc8cec4350c2d0`
- `text.ts`: `671bd4cfc92c6f44bc88e014878e7028bd9f6354f1cc77242ab1a4ac98fb9156`

The temporary recorder lived under this crate's ignored `target/` directory
and is removed after verification. The durable fixture is JSON data only.
